result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within the same priority. That matches the sales rep's open-ticket list.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added the same priority `CASE` ordering the rep query uses and updated the Javadoc. Closed tickets and other regions' tickets are still excluded. `RegionManagerService` calls this method, so the overview picks up the new order without any change there.

The `*Region*` and `*Ticket*` tests passed. I didn't add a test for the new ordering, and I haven't run your T-1 to T-5 example directly. Nothing is committed.
